content.text: I will run a command to compute the total disk usage in KB of all .txt files (non-recursive) in files_directory and print an integer (0 if none).

arguments: {"script":"sizes=$(find files_directory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.txt' -print0 | xargs -0r du -k -c | tail -n1 | awk '{print $1}'); printf \"%s\\n\" \"${sizes:-0}\""}
